ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu; This blended format course includes online sessions Monday and Thursday evenings from 6:00 to 8:00 PM. There are also six site-based classes at the Multi-University Center in Oak Brook from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM on the following Saturdays: 1/24, 2/7, 2/28, 4/4, 4/25 and 5/9. A working microphone and speakers and a high speed internet connection are required to participate in online sessions. See details about Elluminate, the online course delivery system, at www.elluminate.com. This section is for M.S. students in Food Science and Human Nutrition and graduate nondegree seeking students.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Historical Tuition $298.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Historical Tuition $270.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Course Fees $41.00 per Bill Hour.
